col.used: Used by styles and rider profiles

mtm.title: Made-to-measure for {code}
mtm.offBody: Off: nothing of this template is checked, no made-to-measure unit of {code} is quoted or ordered and no fitting is booked for it. The riders' measures are still kept.
mtm.onBody: On: the measures of {code} are checked against the rules below while they are typed and sent; made-to-measure units and fittings may be made.
mtm.offOwner: Made-to-measure is built switched off per template: you start it here when the first made-to-measure order of this garment type comes.
mtm.offOthers: Made-to-measure is built switched off per template: only the Owner starts it (the right to start made-to-measure). Ask the Owner when the first made-to-measure order of this garment type comes.
mtm.failed: Could not read the made-to-measure rules
mtm.noRules: No rule yet: once started only the plausible ranges of the points are asked again.
mtm.noBaseSize: No base size rule: the base size is typed

done.off: Made-to-measure stopped for {code}: nothing of it is checked now.

switch.on1: The measures of {code} are checked against its rules from now on (the rider's link and the office's form).
switch.on2: Made-to-measure units of styles measured with {code} may be quoted and ordered, and fittings booked.
switch.on3: It can be stopped again here; what was made meanwhile stays.
switch.off1: Nothing of {code} is checked any more: no rule, no base size suggestion, no alteration limit.
switch.off2: No new made-to-measure unit of {code} is quoted or ordered and no fitting is booked; a booked one may still be cancelled.
switch.off3: The riders' measures and the units already made stay as they are.
switch.reasonHint: For example: the first made-to-measure order of this garment type.

held.noManage: Changing measurement templates needs the right to keep the style library (product library).
held.noSwitch: Only the Owner starts or stops made-to-measure (the right to start made-to-measure).
held.archivedOn: An archived template is not started: restore it first.
held.archived: The template is archived: restore it to change it.
held.notEditable: This template cannot be changed by you: it belongs to another company.
held.rulesOn: Its made-to-measure is on: the Owner stops it first.
held.stylesUse_one: {count} style is measured with it: give it another template first.
held.stylesUse_other: {count} styles are measured with it: give them another template first.

list.intro: Which body measures are taken per garment type for made-to-measure, in measuring order. Made-to-measure is started per template.
list.moreHint: The first 200 templates are shown: narrow the search to find the others.
list.factsFailed: Could not read how it is used
list.mtmOffHint: Nothing is checked; started per template
list.failed: Could not load the measurement templates

noMatch.title: No templates match these filters
noMatch.body: Remove a filter or clear them all.

empty.title: No measurement templates yet
empty.body: A template names the body measures a fitter takes for one garment type. Create the first one.
empty.bodyView: A template names the body measures a fitter takes for one garment type. The product library's keepers create them.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to measurement templates
forbidden.body: Reading them needs the right to see the style library (product developers, sales, the production manager).

new.title: New measurement template
new.intro: One template per garment type: the points a fitter measures, in order. Made-to-measure starts switched off on it.
new.companyHint: Every company's, or one company's own.
new.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, _ and - ("JACKET", "RACE_SUIT"). It stays once a rider is measured for it.
new.name: Name
new.typeHint: The kind of garment its styles are.
new.copyHint: Its active points are copied: codes, names, units, ranges, how to measure.
new.after: The template opens next: add its points there.

held.code: Type the garment type code: capital letters, digits, _ and -.
held.taken: {code} is a template already: pick another code.
held.name: Type its name.
held.copyFailed: Could not read that template's points: pick it again.
held.copyEmpty: That template has no active point to copy.
held.firstCode: Type the first point's code: letters, digits, _ . and -.

problem.twice: {code} is in the list twice: each point once.
problem.name: Type its name.
problem.number: A number of 0 or more with at most 2 decimals.
problem.order: The lowest is not above the highest.

points.title: Points
points.previewHeld: The template has no point to preview.
points.editIntro: The list is saved whole in its order. A point taken out is archived (kept, no longer measured), never deleted; a kept point keeps its code.
points.codeKept: A kept point keeps its code.
points.name: Name
points.leaving_one: Saving archives {count} point: {codes} (kept, no longer measured).
points.leaving_other: Saving archives {count} points: {codes} (kept, no longer measured).

held.none: A template keeps at least one point.

preview.title: {code} as the fitter sees it
preview.subtitle: Type values to try it: nothing is saved.

record.archivedBanner: Archived: kept with its riders' measures, not offered for new styles.

rename.title: Rename {code}
rename.hint: The code stays; only the name changes.

move.archive1: It is kept with its points; {profiles} rider profile revisions measured for it stay readable.
move.archive2: It is no longer offered for new styles; restore it to use it again.
move.restore1: It is offered for styles again; made-to-measure stays off until the Owner starts it.

used.title: Where used
used.emptyBody: No style is measured with {code} and no rider was measured for it.
used.kept: A style names its template on its record; a rider's profile keeps the garment type it was measured for.
used.openRiders: Riders measured for {code} in Sales › Made-to-measure

problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer: try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not open this.
problem.forbiddenWrite: Your role does not allow this change.
problem.notFound: This template is not here any more.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.contract: The answer was not what this page expects: reload the page.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side: try again.
problem.invalid: The change was refused as it is: check it.
problem.fields: Some fields were refused: they are marked.
problem.moved: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again, check and repeat your change.
problem.codeTaken: That code is a template already: pick another one.
problem.state: It cannot change in the state it is in now: it was read again.
problem.rulesNeedPoints: Its made-to-measure rules still need these points as they are: change the rules first.
